name: C# SDK for Model Context Protocol
headline: C# SDK for Model Context Protocol - Official
short_description: The official C# SDK for Model Context Protocol enables integration for developers working with Model Context Protocol servers and clients. Collaboratively maintained with Microsoft, it provides strong tools for building and managing applications efficiently.
author: modelcontextprotocol

sections.overview:
The C# SDK is the official implementation for Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI agents with external tools and data sources. It provides developers with a complete toolkit for building MCP servers and clients in C#, with strong typing and comprehensive support for protocol operations. Collaboratively maintained with Microsoft, the SDK includes standardized HTTP transport implementation and handles authorization flows including offline access scenarios. The repository contains samples, documentation, and active development reflecting real-world usage patterns. Developers can use this SDK to integrate MCP capabilities into .NET applications and enable AI agents to interact with custom resources.
Integrate Model Context Protocol into existing C# applications to enhance functionality.
Build client-server applications using the csharp-sdk for efficient communication.
Automate data handling processes in C# applications with Model Context Protocol.
Create custom tools and services that interact with LLMs through the SDK.
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: VS Code, GitHub Copilot
